title: SSI disability application for a child under 18: information and documents needed
use_when: The client is a parent or guardian applying for Supplemental Security Income (SSI) disability payments for a child under age 18.
note: Based on the SSA Child Disability Starter Kit checklist (Publication 64-112, August 2024). The responsible lawyer decides what the matter needs.

child-kit.name: Social Security Administration, Child Disability Starter Kit, Publication No. 64-112 (formerly SSA-1171), August 2024

situations.born-abroad: Was the child born in another country?
situations.has-iep: Does the child have an IFSP or IEP?
situations.child-worked: Has the child ever had an employer?
situations.social-services: Do any social service programs or caseworkers have information about the child?
situations.medical-assistance: Does the child have a medical assistance number?

items.label: Name, address, and phone number of any doctor, therapist, hospital, and clinic that has seen or treated the child in the past 12 months
Records in the family's possession related to the child's medical conditions
items.detail: There is no need to ask for or pay healthcare providers for any medical records the family does not have.

items.label: List of medicines the child takes and why
items.detail: For prescription medicines, include the names of the healthcare providers who prescribed them.

items.label: Names, addresses, and phone numbers of any schools the child attended in the past 12 months
items.detail: Including the names of teachers, psychologists, counselors, and speech and other therapists who have seen or treated the child.

items.label: The child's Individualized Family Service Plan (IFSP) or Individualized Education Program (IEP)
items.detail: And any other school records the family may have.

items.label: Names, addresses, and phone numbers of any social service programs, and names of caseworkers, that have information about the child
Name, address, and phone number of another adult who helps care for the child
Names, addresses, and phone numbers of any employers the child has had
An original or certified copy of the child's birth certificate
Proof of the child's U.S. citizenship or legal residency
items.detail: Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Names and Social Security numbers for all the children and adults who live in the household
items.detail: Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Proof of current income for the child and family members living in the household
items.detail: For example, pay stubs, self-employment tax returns, unemployment or other program benefits, child support. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Proof of resources for the child and parents living in the household
items.detail: For example, bank account statements, life insurance policies, certificates of deposit, stocks or bonds. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.
